dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A lover of climbing, I see?

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Of course. The mountains are my playground, and the mountaintops are my laurels of victory!

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Victories against who, I hear you ask? Why, my former self, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Victory is when the mountains you climb today are higher than those you climbed the day before.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: My apologies, this is just how we are in Natlan.

dialogues.speaker: Rumipaq
dialogues.text: Or should I say, this is how most of us Scions of the Canopy think. If you were talking to the Children of Echoes, they'd probably tell you about heading deep into the mountains, rather than climbing them.
